claims.statement: According to the Daly side, Tom Allen was knocked down by Dan Daly in a street fight at Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis, on June 17, 1888.
claims.excerpt: Alien, it would appear, squared off und was ‘‘downed’*’ by Daly
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: According to the Daly party, Tom Allen was knocked out and asked Dan Daly to quit.
claims.excerpt: They all agree, however, that Allen was knocked out and asked Daly to quit,
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen had an abrasion on the left jaw, another on the right ear and a slightly black eye after the street fight.
claims.excerpt: anabrasion on the left jaw, another on the rightear anda slightly Black eye

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Daly were taken to the station after the street fight and gave bond.
claims.excerpt: Allen and Charley Daly were taken to the istation and gave bond

claims.statement: The Police Court case against Tom Allen was continued until Thursday at Allen's request.
claims.excerpt: thé case was continued until Thursday at Allen’s request.

claims.statement: Tom Allen kept a free-and-easy on Market Street, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: The ex-champian himself was found at his **free-and-ecasy’’ on Market street.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Daly says he fought me, did he? Why, he backed up in front of his door before me.
quotes.topic: his version of the street fight

notes: Daly and Allen accounts differ, so the knock-down claims are medium. The street brawl was not a contest, so there is no fight entry.
